crates.name: cargo-upwell
crates.description: Cargo target discovery and probe execution for Upwell developer tooling.

crates.name: upwell
crates.description: A typed Rust application framework with dependency injection, protocol composition, lifecycle management, and generated clients.

crates.name: upwell-app
crates.description: The Upwell protocol-agnostic application core: application and protocol states, plugins, DI runtime, scope planning, lifecycle, and builtins.

crates.name: upwell-axum
crates.description: The Upwell axum/HTTP protocol: controllers, route DI extractors, and the serve loop over the protocol-agnostic upwell-app core.

crates.name: upwell-axum-json-ws
crates.description: JSON request/reply WebSocket protocol for upwell-axum.

crates.name: upwell-axum-macros
crates.description: The Upwell axum/HTTP controller macros (#[controller], #[handlers], route attributes), built on upwell-macros-core. Re-exported through the upwell facade's web module; depend on the facade, not this crate.

crates.name: upwell-axum-stomp
crates.description: STOMP 1.2 WebSocket messaging protocol for upwell-axum.

crates.name: upwell-build
crates.description: Build-script helper for the Upwell registration-backend seam: registers and (on linker-section-scarce targets, or when forced) activates the `upwell_hybrid` cfg that selects the `inventory` backend over `linkme`.

crates.name: upwell-client
crates.description: The Upwell protocol-agnostic client core: the ProtocolTransport abstraction and the typed Client surface generated clients build on. A protocol (upwell-rpc, …) supplies a ProtocolTransport impl.

crates.name: upwell-config
crates.description: Configuration for the Upwell framework: format-agnostic loading (TOML/YAML) plus the DI-integrated Cfg/ConfigManager/reload layer.

crates.name: upwell-core
crates.description: Leaf vocabulary for the Upwell framework: type descriptors, the dependency-edge model, scopes, and the resolver abstraction. Depends on nothing internal.

crates.name: upwell-di
crates.description: The Upwell dependency-injection engine: scope containers, factories, and component descriptors over the core resolver.

crates.name: upwell-dirs
crates.description: Unified application directories for the Upwell framework, injectable as Dir<K>. Standalone: depends only on core and di.

crates.name: upwell-hooks
crates.description: The Upwell hook system: a general lifecycle/event hook framework, generic over the core resolver.

crates.name: upwell-jobs
crates.description: The Upwell job scheduler: declare `#[job]` methods that run on an interval or cron schedule as supervised background tasks, integrated as a plugin over the protocol-agnostic upwell-app core.

crates.name: upwell-jobs-macros
crates.description: The Upwell job macros (#[jobs], #[job]), built on upwell-macros-core. Re-exported through the upwell facade's jobs module; depend on the facade (with the `jobs` feature), not this crate.

crates.name: upwell-macros
crates.description: Procedural macros for the Upwell application framework.

crates.name: upwell-macros-core
crates.description: Shared codegen library for the Upwell proc-macros: attribute parsing, component/hook/method models, descriptor-slice emission, client generation, and crate-path resolution. Reused by upwell-macros and per-plugin macro crates.

crates.name: upwell-rpc
crates.description: The Upwell native RPC protocol: router, extractors, middleware, transports, and the serve loop over the protocol-agnostic upwell-app core.

crates.name: upwell-rpc-macros
crates.description: Typed RPC protocol macros for the Upwell application framework.

crates.name: upwell-tooling-schema
crates.description: Versioned protocol-neutral JSON schema for Upwell developer tooling.

crates.name: upwell-transport
crates.description: Wire transport and status-code types for the Upwell application framework.
